meta.title: QuiTwin - Equicord that survives Discord updates
meta.description: Vencord or Equicord keeps disappearing after Discord updates? QuiTwin installs an update-safe Equicord launcher for Windows in one run.
meta.ogAlt: QuiTwin keeps Equicord installed through Discord updates

a11y.logoAlt: QuiTwin interlocking Q mark in violet and cyan

hero.lede: QuiTwin installs Discord, Equicord, and an update-safe launcher. No service. No scheduled task. No patch ritual.
hero.fineprint: Run once. The downloaded EXE removes itself when installation succeeds.

problem.title: Why does the mod keep disappearing?
problem.copyOne: Traditional Vencord and Equicord installers patch the live Discord host. A Discord update replaces that host with a new stock version, so the patch vanishes.
problem.copyTwo: Reinstalling works until the next update. Blocking updates works until Discord refuses to start. QuiTwin changes the launch boundary instead.

mechanism.intro: Discord updates the installation it knows. Equicord runs from a content-addressed shadow made from the same files.

stock.title: Keep Discord stock
stock.copy: The real app directory stays byte-for-byte updateable, so the native updater can do its job.

twin.title: Build a hardlink twin
twin.copy: QuiTwin creates an immutable shadow runtime from NTFS hardlinks, without duplicating the full Discord install.

equicord.title: Load Equicord there
equicord.copy: Equicord runs in the twin while Discord still sees its original executable and resources paths.

rebuild.title: Rebuild after updates
rebuild.copy: When Discord changes hosts, the next launch restores stock and creates a fresh modded twin.

safeguards.title: Built for the awkward update, not the happy demo.

process.title: No resident process
process.copy: QuiTwin prepares the runtime, launches Discord, and exits. Nothing waits in the tray or runs as a service.

atomic.title: Atomic publication
atomic.copy: Downloads and runtime generations are staged, flushed, and published atomically.

native.title: Native updates stay native
native.copy: Discord keeps its own updater and stock host. QuiTwin does not reimplement Squirrel or freeze the client.

cleanup.title: One file in, zero leftovers
cleanup.copy: The portable installer hands off to the installed launcher, closes, and is deleted before the success sound plays.

proof.title: We forced the failure case.
proof.copy: A real Discord host was made stale and updated through the native updater. The delta failed, the full fallback completed, Equicord survived the direct restart, and the next normal launch returned the host to stock.

install.copy: QuiTwin finds Discord anywhere, or installs Stable if it is missing. It installs Equicord, launches Discord, deletes the portable EXE, and gets out of the way.
install.risk: Client mods are unsupported by Discord and may violate its Terms of Service. Use them at your own risk.

footer.independent: Independent from Discord, Equicord, Vencord, and Squirrel.
